title: Corrective / Preventive Action (CAPA)
description: A Corrective Action Request (CAR) — the governed record ISO 9001 §10.2 requires for a nonconformity. Every reported error becomes one CAR and moves through a defined lifecycle (open → investigating → action_planned → implemented → verifying → closed) with an accountable owner, the processes it affects, root cause, corrective + preventive action, and effectiveness verification. The set of CARs is the corrective-action register. A governed graph entity: every change is a new version on the hash-chained change-control log (§7.5), so the register carries its own audit trail. LOCKED for Phase 1.

id.description: e.g. car.2026.001 — the CAR number, stable for the life of the record.

nonconformance.description: What went wrong — the reported error / nonconformity.

source.description: Where the error was reported / detected.

state.description: Where the CAR is in the corrective-action lifecycle. 'closed' and 'cancelled' are terminal.

owner_role.description: The role accountable for driving this CAR to closure (§02 — a role, never a person).

date_raised.description: When the CAR was opened (ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD).

date_due.description: Target closure date. Past-due open CARs are flagged.

date_closed.description: Set when the CAR reaches a terminal state.

affected_process_refs.description: Processes this nonconformity affects — so the canvas can flag where action is needed.

containment.description: Immediate correction / containment taken before the cause is fixed.

root_cause.description: The underlying cause (e.g. 5-whys). Expected before action_planned.

corrective_action.description: Action to eliminate the cause so it does not recur.

preventive_action.description: Action to prevent the same class of problem elsewhere.

effectiveness_check.description: How closure effectiveness was verified (§10.2 requires it).

risk_refs.description: Risk & Control register entries this CAR relates to.

related_car_refs.description: Other CARs (e.g. a recurrence of a previously closed one).

custom.description: Free-form master data your organization tracks.

status.description: Entity lifecycle (the record itself). The CAPA workflow lives in `state`; a record is never hard-deleted.
